issues: The hero was a 190px-wide grey placeholder card with just PRO and two stub lines, floating on a large empty light-grey field
The sheen was barely visible; the card had no material for the light to bring out
The card was a flat, frontal block with no volume or shadow direction, so the sweep had no physical reason
Across 4.7 seconds there was no copy or layout at all
changes: Sand look (warm display table); the hero is now a 900×567 titanium-black metal card (fictional Corvid Reserve) with brushed grain, laser-etched wordmark, holder name and contactless mark, a champagne-gold chip and a stacked metal edge

The card sits in 3D on the right (rotateY toward the copy, slight rotateX) with two soft shadows that tighten as it lands; the left column carries a 118px editorial headline Metal, / not plastic., 34px body and a CTA pill

The sweep is physically motivated: within the same 32f that the card turns toward the light (rotateY 21°→14°), a 115° band (0.14 soft wash plus 0.5 core) passes once; under the band, lit copies of the brushed grain and etching are revealed by the same mask and the top edge hairline catches
All Q4 limits hold: one sweep on the hero only, clipped to the radius, layers mounted only during the sweep
Rhythm: a heavy no-bounce spring entrance at 0–36, headline lines rising, a 14f hold to read the card, the turn plus sweep at 58–90, the CTA rising, then a 1.5° drift through the hold; 150f total
